nodes.label: React Frontend
nodes.description: User interface. Stores JWT in localStorage and communicates with Express API.

nodes.label: Express API
nodes.description: Node.js 22 backend handling routes, authentication, and database interactions. Deployed as Cloud Functions gen2 (whereWasThatServer).

nodes.label: Passport Authentication
nodes.description: Handles local authentication and Google OAuth.

nodes.label: JWT Token System
nodes.description: Creates and verifies tokens for authenticated API requests.

nodes.label: MongoDB Atlas
nodes.description: Primary data store containing users and places collections.

nodes.label: Sharp Image Processing
nodes.description: In-memory image compression pipeline (server/utils/imageProcessing.js) run on uploads before they reach storage: EXIF auto-rotation and strip, resize to 1600px max width (withoutEnlargement), format-specific quality settings.

nodes.label: Google Cloud Storage
nodes.description: GCS bucket (where-was-that-images) storing uploaded place photos after Sharp compression. Cache-Control set to 1yr. CORS configured via cors.json/gsutil. Images cleaned up automatically on place/user delete via Mongoose pre('deleteOne') hooks.

nodes.label: Cloud Logging
nodes.description: error-logs bucket with 90-day retention; Log Router sink for severity>=ERROR. Classified error handling in POST /places (ValidationError → 400, duplicate-key → 409, unexpected → logged stack trace); production error handler logs stack + request context on 5xx.

connections.description: React sends REST API requests to Express.
Express generates and verifies JWT tokens.
Passport handles login and OAuth flows.
User redirected to Google login and back to callback.
Express reads and writes user and place documents.
Uploaded images (held in memory via Multer) are compressed before storage.
Compressed images uploaded to GCS bucket.
Associated images removed from GCS when a place or user is deleted (pre('deleteOne') hooks).
Structured error logs (severity>=ERROR) routed to the error-logs bucket.
React sends JWT token in Authorization header.

google_oauth_flow: Server redirects to frontend /oauth-success with token
authenticated_request_flow: React sends API request with Authorization header
image_upload_flow: Sharp compresses image: EXIF auto-rotate + strip, resize to 1600px max width, format-specific quality
Compressed image uploaded to Google Cloud Storage bucket (where-was-that-images) with 1yr Cache-Control
image_cleanup_flow: Associated image(s) removed from GCS bucket

security_layers: File type and size validation for uploads (Multer fileFilter)
Automatic image cleanup on place/user delete
Mongoose NoSQL injection CVE patched (dependency audit)
middleware.js/placeRouter.js query construction reviewed 2026-09-14 — low risk (see architecture-map.json stack.security)
